content:
mina: Quick callout — small sampleapp repro for the Go SDK generator + streaming: when the parent ctx is canceled the generator keeps producing and goroutines pile up. Repro attached, running locally.

tyler: can you paste a minimal repro here?

mina: sure, here's the distilled snippet (runs a generator and cancels ctx):

```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
gen := client.Generator(ctx, &gen.Options{Model: "redwood/gpt-small"})
// consumer loop on a separate goroutine
go func(){
  for r := range gen.Stream() {
    _ = r // process
  }
}()
// pretend to cancel after some work
time.Sleep(200 * time.Millisecond)
cancel()
// expecting goroutine to exit, but pprof shows gen.run() goroutine still stuck
```

priya: ugh i've seen this pattern. is there a gen.Close() or Stop() in Go API? python has .close() for generators, right?

mina: not in our current Go public surface — that's the problem. the sampleapp doesn't show how consumers should reliably stop streaming.

sam: sounds like an SDK parity + ergonomics bug. two vectors: 1) provide an explicit Stop/Close on Generator, 2) ensure underlying network reads respect ctx cancel (or set ReadDeadline). do you have a pprof stack?

mina: yes — goroutine stacks show stuck in net.(*netFD).read+0x... -> tls.Conn.Read -> internal websocket read. looks like the read isn't interrupted by context cancel.

tyler: quick idea: add an internal cancel func into Generator that closes the ws/conn and closes result channels. public API: func (g *Generator) Stop() { g.cancel() } 
Also update sampleapp to call defer gen.Stop() right after creation. That should avoid leaks if ctx is canceled elsewhere.

priya: note: if underlying read is blocked in kernel, just calling cancel without closing the net.Conn won't unblock it. we should ensure we close the net.Conn from Stop() so Read returns.

mina: repro steps I included in the GH issue: run sampleapp with `go test -run Repro` + pprof capture after cancel. attached flame and goroutine dump.

sam: can you open GH issue and link the pprof? I'll triage to eng-runtime and eng-ml infra.

mina: opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/1234 with repro and dump.

ops-bot: @mina created issue #1234 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/1234)

tyler: i'll spiking a small PR to add Stop() + example change in sampleapp. will also add a test that a canceled ctx results in no goroutine leaks (using pprof/Goroutine count baseline). aiming for a short PR tomorrow.

priya: also a docs note in the Go quickstart: emphasize `defer gen.Stop()` and show pattern with ctx.WithTimeout so onboarding doesn't hit this.

sam: +1. adding to sprint board and assigning follow-up ticket to eng-runtime. thanks for the clear repro, mina.

mina: thanks all — saved my laptop battery :)

tyler: :shipit:
